summary: Frontend-only end-to-end testing of the new History (Sales History) tab. All requested flows passed: non-super admin sees only their own sales (no group headers), super admin sees all sales grouped per admin (history-group-<email>), summary counts consistent (super=3 >= non-super=1), WhatsApp share opens external URL in new tab, sales creation via Kasir Y/V/K + margin chip + sell form works, ownership-restricted deletes work. All TEST_ sales cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: SalesHistory.jsx: group key falls back to '—' when owner_email is missing; this could visually collide if multiple sales lack owner metadata. Consider a stronger fallback or guard. Not blocking.
shareWA opens https://wa.me/?text=... with no phone number. Browsers/WhatsApp auto-redirect to api.whatsapp.com/send/. Behavior is fine but tester should be aware the final URL is not wa.me.
load() in SalesHistory swallows errors with a generic toast; consider logging server error details for debugging (401s observed in console are from the initial /me probe before login and are benign).
